_assembly: Real Scryfall card data for the draw and goal tests, resolved 2026-10-25 from POST https://api.scryfall.com/cards/collection and trimmed to the fields the simulator reads (same shape as cards.fixture.json). Slice 2 additions (2026-10-25) are the same Scryfall records as the clock corpus decks (the resolved inputs of the replay).
